session_summary: A patient visited a doctor for persistent cough, fever, and fatigue. The doctor prescribed medication, recommended a chest X-ray, and issued a sick leave. Additional tests were scheduled, and the patient was advised to quit smoking.

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Chest X-ray
proposed_actions.description: Patient to schedule chest X-ray at the county hospital radiology department.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want a chest X-ray today or at the latest tomorrow.

proposed_actions.title: Take Medication
proposed_actions.description: Patient to take amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, one thousand milligrams, twice a day, for seven days.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll prescribe amoxicillin with clavulanic acid, one thousand milligrams, twice a day, for seven days.

proposed_actions.title: Take Paracetamol for Fever
proposed_actions.description: Patient to take paracetamol for fever, no more than four tablets a day.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: For the fever take paracetamol, no more than four tablets a day.

proposed_actions.title: Get Sick Leave Certificate
proposed_actions.description: Patient to obtain a sick leave certificate from the doctor and submit it to human resources.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll issue the medical leave certificate now, you take it to human resources.

proposed_actions.title: Undergo Hematology Panel and C-Reactive Protein Test
proposed_actions.description: Patient to undergo hematology panel and C-reactive protein test tomorrow morning on an empty stomach.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: You'll also do a hematology panel and C-reactive protein test, tomorrow morning, on an empty stomach.

proposed_actions.title: Attend Follow-Up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Patient to attend a follow-up appointment on Tuesday, November 10th, at half past eight, with X-ray and test results.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll be waiting on Tuesday, November 10th, at half past eight, with the X-ray and test results.

proposed_actions.title: Enroll in Smoking Cessation Program
proposed_actions.description: Patient to enroll in the smoking cessation program at the clinic.
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I recommend the smoking cessation program at the clinic. I'll put you on the list and the assistant, Mrs. Elena, will call you next week.

decisions: Doctor prescribed medication for the patient's symptoms.
Doctor issued a sick leave certificate for five days.
Doctor recommended a smoking cessation program.
risks: Patient's condition may worsen if symptoms persist or if fever exceeds thirty-nine degrees.
Patient may not attend the follow-up appointment on time.
follow_up_questions: Will the patient attend the follow-up appointment on time?
Is the patient aware of the smoking cessation program details?
